http/conditional#

Conditional and range requests (RFC 9110 §13, §14): entity tags and byte ranges.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let etag = EntityTag(value: "v42", weak: false);
etag.string();                                                 // "\"v42\""
ParsedEntityTags(headers.text("If-None-Match")).tags().weak_matches(etag);

let ranges = ByteRanges("bytes=0-99,-100");
ranges.satisfiable((1000));
for ranges.ranges((1000)) -> range { range.string(); }   // "0-99", "900-999"

Description#

Conditional and range requests (RFC 9110 §13, §14): entity tags and byte ranges.

* in If-Match or If-None-Match matches any existing representation; whether there is (one) is for the caller to say. Lists are bounded by ConditionalLimits (8192 bytes and 128 entries by default).
